text:
deploy-bot: kicking off staged rollout v3.7.0 -> 5% us-west (commit fa12b3c)
deploy-bot: release-notes: https://ci.redwood/release/3.7.0 ; note: circuit-breaker tuning + batching safety net
emma: at ~35s p95 climbed ~140ms in us-west, small bump in 500s :thinking:
rafael: traces show open circuit hits increasing on a tiny subset of clients, looks like threshold too aggressive for some tail patterns
priya: any change to client-side retries or upstream timeouts in this commit?
greg: no client changes. we did relax circuit thresholds to avoid noisy tripping but maybe the conditions inverted for long-tail prompts
ops-bot: alert: us-west-infer-05 reported repeated circuit-open events at 4760012354
emma: recommendation: pause region, pin back to v3.6.8 for us-west, keep global rollout at 5% elsewhere
rafael: agree. regional pin keeps blast radius small and lets us iterate on thresholds without global rollback
deploy-bot: suggested commands:
```
redwood rollout set --commit fa12b3c --region us-west --percent 0 --reason "pause: circuit-breaker regressions"
redwood route set --region us-west --from v3.7.0 --to v3.6.8 --force
```
deploy-bot: executed at 4760012358, v3.7.0 traffic in us-west -> 0%
emma: metrics: p95/p99 back to baseline within 20s, 500s dropped to previous rate :thumbsup:
priya: capturing failing traces and replay dataset: s3://canary-replays/4760012345/circuit-open-replay.tar.gz
greg: followups: revert the aggressive circuit tweak on a hotfix branch, add a canary test that simulates long-tail prompts + intermittent backend latency, and add a metric guard on circuit-open rate per host
rafael: decision: regional pause + pin. no org-wide rollback. hotfix owner: greg, target small-bake in 24h
deploy-bot: release-notes updated: "us-west partial rollout paused and region pinned pending circuit-breaker tuning"
emma: thanks team. will monitor for ripple in other regions and escalate if needed
